newsitem.title: FRANCE: Cheuvreux cautious on property sector -fund mgrs.
newsitem.headline: Cheuvreux cautious on property sector -fund mgrs.

text.p: Brokerage Cheuvreux de Virieu issued a report on Wednesday recommending caution on property stocks, which it believes are now correctly valued on the bourse, portfolio managers said.
The sector, which has recently advanced on falling interest rates and higher prices of some office and residential properties, will be a market performer at best, the report said.

Cheuvreux remains a buyer on Silic, citing its good returns, and Immeuble de France for speculative reasons, but is a seller on Compagnie Fonciere, Fonciere Lyonnaise, Klepierre, Sefimeg, Simco and Unibail.

One portfolio manager said UBS had recently expressed a contrasting view that the sector's advance had just begun, citing supportive measures by the government and strength in the market for new offices.
